description: This file provides a compatibility layer for fetch API using Gaxios and Undici, including dynamic loading of Gaxios, proxy resolution, and patching fetch implementation.

classes.name: GaxiosPrototype
classes.description: Defines the shape of the Gaxios prototype with a default adapter method.

classes.name: GaxiosConstructor
classes.description: Defines the shape of the Gaxios constructor with a prototype property.

classes.name: ProxyAgentLike
classes.description: Represents a proxy agent with optional connect options and proxy URL.

classes.name: TlsAgentLike
classes.description: Represents a TLS agent with optional options including cert and key.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: hasDispatcher
methods.description: Checks if a value has a dispatch function, indicating it is a Dispatcher.

methods.name: hasProxyAgentShape
methods.description: Checks if a value matches the ProxyAgentLike shape.

methods.name: hasTlsAgentShape
methods.description: Checks if a value matches the TlsAgentLike shape.

methods.name: resolveTlsOptions
methods.description: Resolves TLS options (cert and key) from init and agent.

methods.name: urlMayUseProxy
methods.description: Determines if a URL may use a proxy based on noProxy rules and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveProxyUri
methods.description: Resolves the proxy URI to use for a request based on init and environment.

methods.name: loadUndiciRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Dynamically loads undici's Agent and ProxyAgent modules.

methods.name: buildDispatcher
methods.description: Builds a Dispatcher object based on init and URL, considering proxies and TLS.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a module not found error.

methods.name: hasGaxiosConstructorShape
methods.description: Checks if a value matches the shape of a Gaxios constructor.

methods.name: getTestGaxiosConstructorOverride
methods.description: Retrieves a test override for the Gaxios constructor if set.

methods.name: isDirectGaxiosImportMiss
methods.description: Checks if an error indicates a missing direct import of 'gaxios'.

methods.name: loadGaxiosConstructor
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the Gaxios constructor, with support for test override.

methods.name: installLegacyWindowFetchShim
methods.description: Shim to assign fetch to window object if not present.

methods.name: createGaxiosCompatFetch
methods.description: Creates a fetch function that uses Gaxios or the base fetch, with compatibility patches.

methods.name: installGaxiosFetchCompat
methods.description: Installs the Gaxios fetch compatibility layer, patching Gaxios if available.
